zh.summary: 缩短更新时工作台不可用的时间，并在替换内核前验证现有插件环境。
highlights: 下载和完整性校验期间保持当前工作台运行，只在准备应用更新时短暂停止。
新内核会先组合现有 Profile 与插件；发现不兼容时保持当前版本不变并重新打开工作台。
更新界面区分下载、暂停、插件兼容性检查、安装和启动验证，脱敏支持报告保留失败详情。

en.summary: Reduces update downtime and validates existing plugin environments before replacing the core.
highlights: The current workspace remains running during download and integrity verification, pausing only when the update is ready to apply.
The new core composes existing profiles and plugins first; an incompatibility leaves the installed version unchanged and reopens the workspace.
Update progress now distinguishes download, pause, plugin compatibility, installation, and startup validation while the redacted support report retains failure details.
